messages:
maria (PM): Kicking off alignment for the Steelbridge onramp. They need private deploy + HSM-backed keys, 99.9% SLA for inference, and prewarm windows for peak hours. Can we map deps, owners, and gating criteria?
ajay (Eng): Ack. Main unknowns: HSM integration effort, prewarm orchestration, and whether Dedicated pools suffice or we need on-prem nodes.
katie (Runtime): For prewarm: we can do targeted KV-cache prefill + prefix caching. Need sequence lengths and expected QPS shape from the customer. Also want to know quantization profile they accept.
maria (PM): Customer provided traffic shape (rough): 80% short-chat (<=128 tokens), spikes to 2000 rps for 2x 30min windows daily. They insist on HSM for keys and cannot accept cloud KMS fallback without fallback policy documented.
leo (Infra): For 2k rps bursts we should reserve Dedicated pool capacity with burst autoscale. If on-prem, we need rack/GPUs + network setup. ETA for infra readiness if Dedicated in our DC: ~3 weeks, on-prem: depends on customer's side.
sam (Security): HSM constraints: we need to validate supported HSM vendors, key provisioning flows, attestation, and audit logging. If they forbid remote KMS, we need a private HSM or HSM proxy in their VPC. Also require threat model signoff.
ajay (Eng): Concrete asks for teams: Runtime -> prewarm + cache eviction policy; Infra -> capacity/placement + autoscale policy; Security -> HSM acceptance tests + audit log schema; Product -> rollout gating & customer acceptance criteria.
katie (Runtime): Proposed runtime acceptance tests: 1) cold-start latency under target (p90 < 150ms for short-chat), 2) KV-cache hit rate > 60% after prewarm script, 3) graceful fallback to smaller model with <2s added latency under overload. I'll sketch test harness.
maria (PM): Rollout gating: (A) Security signoff on HSM + audit logs, (B) Infra capacity reserved for pilot, (C) Runtime perf tests pass on staging with production-shaped load, (D) Customer acceptance trial for 72h. Anyone disagree?
sam (Security): Agree but add requirement: tamper-evidence verification and key rotation runbook validated. Also need SOC/Compliance checklist entry for this tenant.
leo (Infra): Noted. I'll open infra tickets: CID-4821 (Dedicated reservation + autoscale policy), CID-4822 (Network/VPC routing for HSM proxy), CID-4823 (staging cluster ingress). ETA: tickets today, implementation ~2 weeks.
ajay (Eng): I'll make runtime PRs and link them to infra tickets. For quantization: if they require higher quality we may default to q3f16; otherwise recommend q4_0 for cost. Need product sign-off.
maria (PM): Product decision: start with q3f16 for pilot to be conservative. If cost is a blocker post-pilot, we'll discuss quant tradeoffs.
katie (Runtime): Example prewarm job snippet to validate cache warming (will add to PR):
```
# prewarm.sh - run from staging harness
curl -X POST $STAGING_API/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":64}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
# run N jobs parallel to simulate spike
```
maria (PM): Owner summary: Product: maria (PM) -> acceptance/runbook; Eng: ajay -> runtime changes; Runtime: katie -> prewarm & perf tests; Infra: leo -> tickets + capacity; Security: sam -> HSM signoff.
deploy-bot: Deployment job queued: steelbridge-staging/1 -> started by ajay.
ajay (Eng): Quick ask for sequencing: can infra allocate Dedicated pool before runtime PR lands? We prefer parallel work to hit timeline. leo?
leo (Infra): Yes, we'll reserve but mark as "hold for verification" until runtime tests pass. Reservation doesn't incur full build-out until signoff.
maria (PM): Timeline proposal: Week 0: tickets & HSM vendor scoping; Week 1: infra reservation + runtime PRs + staging prewarm tests; Week 2: security signoff + pilot rollout (72h). Objections?
sam (Security): No objections. I'll schedule a brief review session tomorrow to run through the HSM checklist.
katie (Runtime): I'll push a perf harness branch today and drop the link once CI runs.
ajay (Eng): Adding acceptance criterion: rollbacks must occur automatically to model-variant vX if latency > 2s for 5min. I'll document in PR.
maria (PM): Great. I'll consolidate this thread into a short runbook and link to the tickets. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
